hook.line: Claude just dropped a feature called Mods, but most people have no idea how to use it.
hook.visual: Top half cream canvas: an orange Claude cube drops in, a 'Mods' title appears and small mod cubes fan out; bottom half he talks into a handheld mic.

beats.what: Orange cube drops onto the cream canvas while the news line starts
'Mods' title with a ring of labelled mini-cubes around the big cube
Large faded '1' marks the first tip
Two dark Session A and Session B windows pass a message card between them
Two cubes labelled PLANS and BUILDS hand tasks back and forth
Full-screen mock dashboard of agents with Running and Waiting pills
Easy tasks list next to an 'Opus $$$' card for tip three
Mod node routes easy requests to Haiku and hard ones to Opus
Prompt bubble 'Build me a mod...' and the cube building a dashed box
Full-face shot with a Follow card popping up over his hand

characters.enters: Drops in from the top of the canvas at 0 s
characters.acts: Spawns mini mod cubes, splits into PLANS and BUILDS cubes that pass tasks, then builds a new box from a prompt
characters.exits: Gives way to full-screen UI cards and code

why_it_works: News framing plus 'no one is talking about' promises insider value in the first 3 s
The top-half animation literally acts out each tip (two sessions passing a message), so the idea lands without reading
One recurring cube character ties every tip together visually
Follow card appears as a UI pop-up on the exact line asking for the follow
weaknesses: Loop score 0.545; the ending does not lead back to the start
Small mono caption chunks on the seam compete with the diagrams
for_robert: Copy the recurring object that acts out each point: Fred can drop in at the hook, then split, carry and build things in the top half for each tip, and return for the follow.
